next_question.rationale: All rate-bearing cuts tried so far point to routing/availability and client-side drops (instant/online requests and 'abandoned by system'), but payments/coverage could still explain some created→confirmed failures if insurer flows or corporate-pay verification trigger auto-cancels. Requesting payer (self-pay / insurance / corporate) will show whether a particular payer segment has materially lower created→confirmed conversion; if so the mechanism is payer verification/payment approval rather than doctor availability. Also_dimension is null because payer is the only remaining rate-bearing dimension not yet tried.
